name: Burrow Pages
description: Your static websites on your own addresses: from GitHub or GitLab (any number of accounts, built in a container when they need it), from any Git repository, from an upload, a repository's own Pages site, a site that lives elsewhere, or a port of an app on this machine or any of your Machines. Every push deployed, any deploy one click from live again, visitor numbers without cookies, health checks, and your login, a password or public for each.
author: Alexd Aero

actions.label: Pause every site
actions.confirm: Every site stops answering until you resume it. Nothing is deleted.

settings.label: GitHub app client ID
settings.help: The GitHub OAuth app “Sign in with a code” uses (device flow). Burrow Pages' own is filled in; its client ID is public and there is no secret. Burrow Pages → Settings can override it too.

update_card.title: {name} {version}
update_card.tagline: Ports: an app on this machine or on any of your Machines, as a site, and your Tunnels-tab port tunnels can move in.
highlights: A port on a machine: an app on this machine or on one of your Machines, on its own address
WebSockets, self-signed https and the visitor's address passed on, like a real reverse proxy
Port tunnels from the Tunnels tab move in at the same address with the same password
…and move back to the Tunnels tab any time
Other machines need Aegis × Burrow 2.31 (it forwards their port over the Machines link)
